title: Shopping
shortDescription: Ask for help finding something, sizes, prices, and check out.
communicativeGoals: Ask for help finding an item
conversationMoves: Help the learner find an item
React naturally to what they're looking for rather than following a script
warmUpPrompts: What are you shopping for today?
Do you have a size or color in mind?
rolePlayPrompts: Ask for a different size or color of something you tried on.
Ask whether an item is on sale or available in another store.
challengePrompts: Negotiate or ask about a price match.
Return or exchange an item and explain why.
successCriteria: Learner clearly states what they're looking for
Learner asks about at least one detail (size, price, availability)
Learner completes the transaction with appropriate language

suggestedReviewItems.content: 'Do you have this in a different...?' for requesting alternatives
